Draw from a normal distribution using a specific seed

rnorm_with_seed.Rd

Draws random numbers with stats::rnorm() using the given seed and R's default random number generators, and restores the global random number generator state and kind afterwards, so that the session's random number stream is not affected.

Usage

rnorm_with_seed(n, mean = 0, sd = 1, seed = NULL)

Arguments

n

number of draws

mean

mean of the normal distribution

sd

standard deviation of the normal distribution

seed

integer random seed. If NULL, draws from the current random number generator state without restoring it.

Value

numeric vector of length n
